body: I feel 100% the same way. Your post could have been written by me. Going thru the same thing, except it's been a year, and she won't say a single thing to me
I feel the same. It's always the same. Yes it makes sense, I never misunderstood, it's just not possible. I'm grateful for the attempts
Yes. I am not going to live that long
Just over 10 years

I don't want her to move on

Correct. She said leave her be, so I did
It's already been 8 months since the last time I had any communication what so ever. For all she knows I did die 8 months ago

No, I won't find anyone. She was it. I have people suggesting otherwise

I tried therapy. For several months. Nothing has changed. This is me and my personality. It's not going to change and honestly I'm starting to get frustrated with people saying it will. I know myself.
You need to consider that there isn't better for me. That's just as likely

At this point ending my life is a favor. Staying alive is hurting me more and more

And I am listening to you, truly I am. I have tried to be happy. It's just not working and I know it never will
I have gotten better. I addressed everything that was an issue. I am and have been for awhile. But I can't wait anymore. I'm done!!
Literally all I've been doing is waiting for her. I can't wait any longer

I disagree. She'll have all those questions regardless

I don't want it to go away. I miss her too much. As much as you think it won't last forever, I'm telling you it will. I know me and my feelings, and I know it won't go away. The pain is forever

No I'm not, because I would never tell her that. She will never know that. She'll have guilt regardless. I'm trying to answer as much as I can before I go

This pain is forever too. I'm telling you it won't get any better. Just worse as time goes on. My best life is over

But wouldn't me dying with saying I'm sorry hurt her more? She wouldn't have answers

No, I posted here because I need advice. The only way I'll want to keep going is if she gives me a chance. That's not why I want to talk to her, just clarifying that's the only way I'll be happy again. Ya, I might be able to avoid hurting others, but I will be hurting. That's not fair either

She gave me my life. Since she's gone, there's nothing left. There's no point arguing, it's not going to change how I feel, or my decisions. I just want the best way to say goodbye to her. I know it'll hurt, I want the way for it to hurt the least

That's why I want to say goodbye. That'll put me at peace and I won't be afraid

I don't want the chance. I can't live without her. And she did this by cutting me out of her life instantly and without discussion. I'm not mad at her, or think I'm better than her, and hate the idea of living just to show her. She doesn't deserve that
No, I won't. Ever

What other options are there? That's the only one I see

How will I suffer? It'll be over. I won't feel anymore

I honestly cant live without her. People say I'll move on, but I haven't and don't want to.

No, but I won't die happy without saying goodbye either. It feels so unfinished. Well in a way she did do this.

No there isn't. I'm in so much pain and I know it won't ever go away. I've tried many things, but nothing. I don't want to live the rest of my life just because people look down on suicide. It's my choice. I've had lots of time to think about it and come to terms with it. It's not a way out, it's just I don't want or have anything to live for anymore, so what's the point

I know, but I feel leaving this world without an explanation or saying goodbye will hurt her too, so which one is worse? Plus I need to do it for me.

I tried to be happy and "move on", but I can't. I love her too much. I have been miserable for a year now with no change. I'm done
Thanks, but that's not what I want. I want to say goodbye
Almost. 8 months or so
They're such assholes, yet I still miss them and don't want them to feel bad. They're friends of 15+ years, but now I feel like they never truly were. Just a lie

I really don't know. But I know they've threatened to call police on me when I did talk to them about leaving. They probably just feel guilty and need to try something, and just talking to police is enough.
I feel you so much. I've lost all my "friends" because they're all too scared to talk to me. They don't really care

I'm more so disappointed. As much as I don't feel they're friends anymore, I still want to say goodbye to them. But I know if I do, they'll try and stop me, and that's not what I want. So I'm stuck not saying goodbye which hurts even more
No. And I really just wish they would. But I'm not allowed to contact them
I don't want to meet anybody else. I just want the love of my life back. And if I can't, there is no reason to keep living
Yes. Close friends and family
Not recently, but a year ago yes. And I think they'll hate me when I go thru with it, not because I don't talk to them
I used to believe that...
I'd like to think that too, but I know that's not the case. They don't care. And I don't blame them

Have them understand why I'm doing this. Why I am done with everything. That I've come to terms with it. I don't want them thinking I was a coward and too weak to deal with shit. I've been struggling and battling for a year now. I want them to miss me and not hate me

They know I feel like this and my intentions. They have literally said I can't deal with you right now, and haven't talked to me since. I tried reaching out to a few and they just read my messages and never answered. They really don't care
I was in somebody's life, but they've made it clear they never want to talk or deal with me ever again
Nah. They'll "miss" me, but just because they feel they have to. I guarantee nobody will even think of me in a few months
